## Texas Hemp THC Ban Takes Effect
Texas' ban on most hemp-derived THC products [took effect Friday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGy2yAURL8GdXjgAhIUFGnUvbQpNQguFpNr4QFiPf99xvmF1Luzs-f8-tq-QqFy3n-GB_rxnet24tUJx8C2vQNRHw1x3Ct2Ki9slQhb3EDAzIXlQm0pFHpvekp-F8nJCb1crFmMdiCnwyewYcnaBrUra3Wal6wWLQPYaGYDair-MyasUFIKEOI2Q3AqySxRBeNSZlpgKqO22zhw4Hfomd71he0W62Mif4zx7Ez9YLAyWK_ruv3Gs5tPymANbZRIyGD9gDFYqcZADNZxRN6wj1biKPXs_MDHk-9_ejmxd_xUwRquMoLSgNzsYeE674I7tyTupNFKoM3RzVPz6XkVotLnhWlxf4RC_96N_3P68vA3AAD__84DiV0), pulling delta-8, delta-10, and THCA flower off store shelves statewide. The ban stems from a [Texas Supreme Court ruling](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1u7CAQBeCnwR2rAfxbUNzG3d42pcWa8YIyayyY2Ou3j5w8Qppp5ujT0fm4T3cXKa7P_-6Flt9LmlY8CiEz5ul0RIUzIj8TFoo75kSEeZ406FZCL8FM3kU6p7ry9gF-UBVa1fVN19SDVlWwavBDZ3pooTfd3GrTGmeGRzPXjUKFUEV7YdCDUQo0wK3VbjBeLQqNawa_iBrQR075xgEZ364sdKYd821Or4psYN6KMP-EHoUe-STMm9t-30KPly70CP111JW4CBlckQ-3ruhlwR2zI8lhlltO_mvmIgNmLPIIjiUn-bmmQ-ixytZvRySKpe1EDc-Xi_RTg_823m71dwAAAP__tb6DGw) in May that let state health officials classify synthetic hemp-derived THC as a Schedule I drug. Possession is now a state jail felony carrying up to two years and $10,000 in fines. Hemp retailers and a manufacturer [filed a federal lawsuit](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2u2zAQhE9DdRSWS_1QBYs06l7alMJKXFoE1tIDxZj27QMbyAleNcUAH2a-P1_LFyVJx-033dmXZzyXg-slXArn5UUiV8nM5XbyJenB-RThvC0IOGhwGuwSKMlr6ZrgVwiTadib0fVj301omt1DdNAjIgRHkW0wQ79CHKiPKw6A3CT_hoEDawwgQDsgTTaYaNhSP4WoOuCQypnbsnPhJ11RXueDc7ud90b8Xsr3pewvhbPCudba1kj0LhXOlEvahBXO718KZzk3EoXzB_Q_ddk3vdKhD646cuBMooXq9TcVhTO6UU8ruWmMVmOcet3ZzmlyJmiMgTt0liwPTfbhuyaRdA2j6uB2pySfleVnbh8e_wUAAP__XnaMDg) on July 31 to block the ban, arguing it conflicts with the 2018 farm bill that legalized hemp nationwide. Cannabis experts estimate the change could pull [60% to 90% of products](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2O5CAQxfHT4KxafLVtAoJNnM2mG1plKNpocGNBqad9-9XMFSZ-0k9P_38f6wfmkp-Pv3iQ53eq65O-eiFmauuFpXRuRPyo1Et-UaulUAurlnoEOYM0a8RcrtUO0W8yOjWQV9N8n-7WaTXsXs0mbHOK0ZjgEk3WorVxk5tzGEYXhuy_MTlLo5TUUt5Gjc5ElRQZvLuYhJUUM9d2452Y3thTueqL2i3UYyh-Zz67MH-EXoRecAvKfC9CL2ftLPTSj_pJ0Pd6djjwglRboAih1E6AR47wo8JOxwm8B9jwCYyf1IFSosBA75Mad-h4Cb0oNypjpknoZWg-nl-5lNzHSVj5ODCXn1_8u5ovr_8HAAD__-n7isw) from roughly 14,000 licensed stores statewide. "_It is going to do irreparable harm_ ," said Mark Bordas of the Texas Hemp Business Council. Supporters, citing rising cannabis poisoning calls involving children, welcomed the change. "_It's about time_ ," said Aubree Adams of Citizens for a Safe and Healthy Texas.

body:
I simply cannot fight back and win without your help.

Our Senate race is heating up, Peter.

Over the past couple months, we’ve received an outpouring of grassroots support from people who are fed up with what’s happening in our country and ready for change.
Those folks know we can’t let my opponent, Washington DC insider Michael Whatley, and his MAGA allies buy this seat.
Their $5 and $10 donations are critically important: Experts say that Democrats have no chance at taking back the Senate without winning in North Carolina.
**Now, Republicans are seeing our momentum, and they’re starting to panic.** President Trump and JD Vance are personally attacking me with lies and spreading misinformation – and the GOP’s super PAC just launched its largest ad reservation _in the country_ here in North Carolina.
**Peter, the GOP’s attacks are working: A recent poll shows my slim lead down to four points – just above the margin of error.**
[**I’m confident in the grassroots movement we’re building, but I simply cannot fight back and win without your help. Please, Peter, will you chip in $5 or more today to help us flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate?**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk987&amount=5&t=8&akid=2447%2E124072%2EE_C_mG)

It details how many or most Democrats want their Senate candidates in Montana and South Dakota to drop out and clear the way for Independents [Seth Bodnar](https://substack.com/redirect/9e2a1f34-b8a4-4932-9691-a42a61ff2fc1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [Brian Bengs](https://substack.com/redirect/21f98796-52e3-4ecb-98cf-5682d708abdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to have one-on-one matchups with the Republican candidates in these 2 reliably red states because the Democrats have no chance to compete while Seth and Brian do.
For example, in Montana, [Seth Bodnar](https://substack.com/redirect/9e2a1f34-b8a4-4932-9691-a42a61ff2fc1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is statistically tied with the Republican Kurt Alme if it's one-on-one, while the Democrat Alani Bankhead polls way behind in every circumstance. The Democrat Bankhead raised only $35,000 this quarter, with only $21,000 on hand (!!!). Meanwhile, Seth Bodnar raised over $1.1 million with almost $1 million on hand. Kurt Alme, the Republican raised $800,000 and has $1.4 million on hand.
Read that again: the Independent [Seth Bodnar](https://substack.com/redirect/9e2a1f34-b8a4-4932-9691-a42a61ff2fc1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) raised 30 times more this quarter and has almost 50 times more money than the Democrat and is essentially at parity with the Republican. This is categorically a race where the Democrat is the spoiler.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a6d6a12f-53a0-4b9c-b20a-2b95f94169b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The Dem nominee in Montana, Alani Bankhead, says "nobody ever knows what's actually going to happen in an election," and "absolutely nothing" short of an act of God will get her to drop out of the race. Meanwhile, Nancy Keenan, the former executive director of the Montana Democratic Party who has endorsed Bodnar along with former Senator Jon Tester wrote that "there is not a viable path for a Democratic victory in this race."
It's infuriating that a candidate with no real shot is going to give this race to the Republican. Talk about a spoiler.
The gulf in South Dakota between Independent [Brian Bengs](https://substack.com/redirect/21f98796-52e3-4ecb-98cf-5682d708abdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and Democrat Julian Beaudion is not quite as enormous - $113,000 to $18,000 this quarter - but the dynamic is the same. [Bengs](https://substack.com/redirect/21f98796-52e3-4ecb-98cf-5682d708abdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the Independent, polls competitively with South Dakota Republican Senator Mike Rounds while Beaudion is a non-factor statewide.
As a former candidate myself, I've always been reluctant to call on anyone to drop out of a race. Deciding to run for office is a huge personal commitment, and the sacrifice deserves some measure of deference and respect. That said, for these 2 candidates, the choice to continue is clearly playing into the hands of the opposition.
Will they do the right thing?
I confess to being totally rapt as to whether Alani Bankhead and Julian Beaudion will adopt some common sense and drop out. I've been surprised by the level of press and near un-animity that Bankhead and Beaudion should step aside. If they continue to run as no-hope candidates, they will ensure that there's no genuine competition in these 2 U.S. Senate races. Alternatively, if they step aside and clear the way for Independent candidates with genuine followings to provide real challenges to their opponents, they could change national politics for the better.
For Beaudion in South Dakota, decision day is tomorrow. The deadline for Bankhead in Montana to see the light is August 10th. We will find out very quickly if South Dakota and Montana join Nebraska and [Idaho](https://substack.com/redirect/7ea84c1e-ed26-4dc5-8910-1886ae95d4d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as states where Independent candidates are creating contests where no one expected. I hope they do, for the good of the country.

| | Dear Fellow American,

**I’m excited to let you know about our free documentary course, “Marxism, Socialism, and Communism,” which will educate you on the dangers and problems inherent in these destructive ideologies. Every American—but especially our young people—should understand these ideologies.**

Today, Marxism goes by different names to make itself seem less dangerous. I'm sure you've heard of "critical race theory," "gender theory," or even "decolonization."

I know these disguises do not fool you.

“Marxism, Socialism, and Communism” is one of our most important courses **because the source of these dangerous ideologies is still Karl Marx.**

It’s the same Marxism that works to destroy your property and your country.

It’s the same Marxism that seeks to abolish your family and your God.

And it’s the same Marxism that leads to famines, show trials, gulags, and other atrocities.

The truth is, there's nothing fundamentally _new_ about this "new" Marxism, except for one crucial fact...

**... it's more popular with our youth than ever before. **

By way of example, the mayor of our largest city vowed to replace “rugged individualism” with the “warmth of collectivism.” Clearly, this issue isn’t going away.

That’s why I invite you to gain a deeper understanding of the history of Marxism as well as the threat it poses to our liberty.

[**You can do that by registering for “Marxism, Socialism, and Communism” today.**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcuK3DAQRb9G3tnoZVu98CLB09lkJuQBsxSaUrW7QC8seZL8fRhw_0C2deAUh_v6bJ8dBUrbi4u4UK3WZ2-j2_9QjVvG-vbX0-2GO6aWXLSSy6nnpufKOmj0jla7zi-jFOZmOlzEbMZ5NNMkuvsCXM2zHsUb6EmAvniJggsUo-beGwMdLR8-brgSkmthBkBzcQizGUFfJgSm-VG8azhQquSxQs6l5ECNoA5537qw3FsrlalPTF6ZvFK65eFOIVTvAg7oDyavZ09faUv9UZi6VmBq5WIazQuXWn6VYv22Pj39ZHI6WrQ1HzsgU2vZcy0IjdJ2ooiejsjUitFROI_gYnG0JabW89cD5NQwNabWz1_s97l__fWjfzR3--LLbwqB6jQzzbcP4QA5du1_l3hf5L8AAAD__7kwmQg)

This free online course is more urgent than ever. We are at a critical time for our country, and Marxism--under a variety of names--continues to infiltrate our culture.

**Will you join us by registering for this free online course?** You can click on the secure link below to register and get your access today:

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/marxism-sign-up**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcuK3DAQRb9G3tnoZVu98CLB09lkJuQBsxSaUrW7QC8seZL8fRhw_0C2deAUh_v6bJ8dBUrbi4u4UK3WZ2-j2_9QjVvG-vbX0-2GO6aWXLSSy6nnpufKOmj0jla7zi-jFOZmOlzEbMZ5NNMkuvsCXM2zHsUb6EmAvniJggsUo-beGwMdLR8-brgSkmthBkBzcQizGUFfJgSm-VG8azhQquSxQs6l5ECNoA5537qw3FsrlalPTF6ZvFK65eFOIVTvAg7oDyavZ09faUv9UZi6VmBq5WIazQuXWn6VYv22Pj39ZHI6WrQ1HzsgU2vZcy0IjdJ2ooiejsjUitFROI_gYnG0JabW89cD5NQwNabWz1_s97l__fWjfzR3--LLbwqB6jQzzbcP4QA5du1_l3hf5L8AAAD__7kwmQg)

You're one of the reasons why we can defend liberty by producing and promoting courses like "Marxism, Socialism, and Communism"--so thank you so much for all you do.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

body:
This is not something Jon — or anyone else — can do alone. It takes all of us.
# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=2613%2E5691347%2EU7nWoM)

Peter,
Donald Trump is weaponizing the entire federal government against his enemies. He sent the FBI to _raid an election office_ right here in Georgia.
We are witnessing a power grab unprecedented in our nation’s history. To stop MAGA and reverse this slide into an un-American America, we MUST take back Congressional power in the midterms.
_And the path to a Senate majority simply does not exist without reelecting Jon here in Georgia._
That’s why Trump and MAGA have made Jon Ossoff their #1 target, and it’s why the GOP is gearing up to spend hundreds of millions of dollars on this race alone.
It’s also why we need to ask for your help.
To win this race, we are going to have to fight back against hundreds of millions of dollars worth of attack ads while at the same time building the biggest voter mobilization program in Senate campaign history.
_That is no small task._ And it is not something Jon — or anyone else — can do alone. It takes all of us.

# Join Us For An Election Day Phonebank!
---
| |
## _Anytime, Anywhere: One Final Push_
---
| |
**Hi everyone,**
**Election Day is almost here, and we're making one final push to reach voters before the polls close!**
**Join us virtually for our FINAL Election Day phonebank for Elizabeth Dempsey Beggs. This is an all-day, drop-in event—our Google Meet will be open from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, so you can hop on whenever you have time. Whether you can make calls for 20 minutes, an hour, or several hours, every conversation helps.**
**Never phonebanked before? No problem! We'll get you set up with a quick training and all the support you need. Experienced campaign staff and volunteers will be available throughout the day to answer questions, celebrate wins, and keep the energy high.**
**This is our last chance to introduce Elizabeth to voters in the 1st District before the polls close, and every call could make the difference. So pop into the Google Meet whenever it works for you, and help us finish strong. We can't wait to see you there!**
**Let's make every call count!****See you on Election Day,
Elizabeth**
